changes.text: 一种解释是，「厚民生」排在「徵兵、轉餉」之前，是把争议最小、也最难被驳倒的目标放在最前面：台谏说的是「鐵路之害」，而不至引敌、坟庐易避这两条或许是对着「害」字去答的（传文未记台谏所指何害）。作者推断这种写法出于策略考虑，传文没有写他的思考过程，此处是作者的解释。

One reading: putting "enriching livelihoods" before "raising troops and forwarding supplies" sets the least contested, hardest-to-topple goal at the front. The censors spoke of "the harms of railways," and the two points about not drawing in the enemy and easily avoiding graves and houses may answer the word "harms," though the biography does not record which harms were meant. The author infers that this drafting is tactical; the biography records no thought process, so this is the author's interpretation.

dispositions.rationale: 利一原文是「無慮引敵」，意思是不必担心铁路把敌人引进来，不是“避敌”。现将中文“避敌、避坟庐这两条”改为“不至引敌、坟庐易避这两条”，英文同步改为 "not drawing in the enemy and easily avoiding graves and houses"，与原文及 story.1 的转述一致。其余文字未动。

evidence.quote: 內處腹地，無慮引敵，利一；原野廣漠，墳廬易避，利二
